## Structure

Every Segment API call has a core set of common fields plus method-specific fields. All timestamps are ISO-8601 UTC strings.

### Common Fields

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|-------|----------|------|-------------|
| `userId` | if `anonymousId` not set | String | Unique identifier for user in your database |
| `anonymousId` | if `userId` not set | String | Pseudo-unique substitute for cases without absolute identifier |
| `context` | optional | Object | Extra contextual data like IP, locale, device info |
| `integrations` | optional | Object | Dict of destination names to send to (true/false). Defaults: `{All: true, Salesforce: false}` |
| `messageId` | implicit | String | Auto-generated unique identifier per message (max 100 chars) |
| `timestamp` | optional | Date | When the event occurred (ISO-8601). If omitted, server uses current time. Required for historical data imports. Calculated as: `receivedAt - (sentAt - originalTimestamp)` |
| `sentAt` | optional | Date | When message was sent to Segment API (ISO-8601). Auto-set by libraries. Used for clock skew correction. |
| `receivedAt` | implicit | Date | When Segment server received the message (ISO-8601). Auto-set. |
| `event` | method-specific | String | Event name (for track calls) |
| `type` | implicit | String | Message type: `'identify'`, `'group'`, `'track'`, `'page'`, `'screen'`, or `'alias'` |
| `version` | implicit | Number | API version (auto-set by Segment) |

## Context Object

Optional dict providing contextual data. Use fields only for their intended meaning.

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `active` | Boolean | Whether user is active. Flags Identify calls to update traits without updating "last seen" |
| `app` | Object | App info: `name`, `version`, `build`. Mobile libraries collect automatically. |
| `campaign` | Object | Campaign/UTM info: `name`, `source`, `medium`, `term`, `content`, and custom UTM params. Analytics.js auto-collects. |
| `device` | Object | Device info: `id`, `advertisingId`, `adTrackingEnabled`, `manufacturer`, `model`, `name`, `type`. **Note:** iPhone model values may not match model numbers (e.g., iPhone 15 Pro Max = `iPhone16,2`). Mobile libraries auto-collect. |
| `ip` | String | Current user's IP address. Server-side only; Segment fills from request for client-side events. IPv6 not supported. |
| `library` | Object | Library info: `name`, `version`. All libraries auto-collect. |
| `locale` | String | Locale string, e.g. `en-US`. Auto-collected by all libraries. |
| `network` | Object | Network info: `bluetooth`, `carrier`, `cellular`, `wifi`. If both `cellular` and `wifi` are false/empty, user is offline. Mobile libraries auto-collect. |
| `os` | Object | OS info: `name`, `version`. Mobile libraries auto-collect. |
| `page` | Object | Page info: `path`, `referrer`, `search`, `title`, `url`. Analytics.js auto-collects. |
| `referrer` | Object | Referral info: `type`, `name`, `url`, `link` |
| `screen` | Object | Screen info: `density`, `height`, `width`. Mobile libraries auto-collect. |
| `timezone` | String | Timezone as `tzdata` string, e.g. `America/New_York`. Auto-collected by all libraries where available. |
| `groupId` | String | Group/Account ID. Useful for B2B attribution of non-group calls. |
| `traits` | Object | User traits dict, same format as Identify call traits. Useful when tracking an event and associating prior Identify data. |
| `userAgent` | String | User agent string. Analytics.js auto-collects; Android libraries auto-collect. |
| `userAgentData` | Object | User Agent Client Hints API data: `brands`, `mobile`, `platform` (always); may include `bitness`, `model`, `platformVersion`, `uaFullVersion`, `fullVersionList`, `wow64`. Analytics.js only. |
| `channel` | String | Origin of request: `'server'`, `'browser'`, or `'mobile'` |

Mobile libraries (Swift, Kotlin, React Native) do not auto-collect context for subsequent calls — use plugins to add context fields.

## Integrations Object

Dict mapping destination names to boolean (true = send, false = don't send). Special key `'All'` applies when no specific destination key is found.

Default:
```json
{
  "All": true,
  "Salesforce": false
}
```

Salesforce defaults to false due to strict API call limits. All other destinations are opt-out.

## Timestamps

All four timestamp fields are ISO-8601 UTC strings. Segment uses them for different purposes:

| Timestamp | Source | Calculated As | Purpose |
|-----------|--------|---|---------|
| `originalTimestamp` | Client device clock OR manual `timestamp` via server libraries | — | Helps calculate corrected `timestamp`. **Not useful for analysis** — spoofable and affected by clock skew. |
| `sentAt` | Client device clock when request sent (auto-set by library) OR manual value | — | Helps calculate corrected `timestamp`. **Not useful for analysis** — tainted by device clock skew. |
| `receivedAt` | Segment server clock when message arrived | — | Auto-set. Used as sort key in Warehouses. **For max query speed when chronology doesn't matter.** Chronological order not guaranteed. |
| `timestamp` | Calculated by Segment | `receivedAt - (sentAt - originalTimestamp)` | Clock-skew corrected timestamp sent to destinations and historical replays. **Recommended for analysis when chronology matters.** |

**Note on Engage:** Must use ISO-8601 with timezone info for custom traits; missing timezone causes timestamp to be discarded.

### Manual Timestamp via Server Libraries

If using server Source libraries or HTTP API, you can manually set `timestamp` in the payload. This updates `originalTimestamp`. Client-side libraries generate their own and don't accept manual override.

### Timestamp Discrepancies

Events may appear with past/future timestamps due to:
- Manual override with past date
- Analytics.js Retries feature queueing events offline (original timestamp preserved)
- Mobile app backgrounded/closed, events queued until app reopened
- Inaccurate client device clock
- Bot traffic with unusual timestamps
